options: A programming language used to store data
A procedure consisting of multiple steps with a set of instructions for a desired result
A table that holds the output of a query
A hardware device that speeds up processing
A diagram of how data flows between systems
questions.explanation: An algorithm is a procedure made up of multiple steps with a set of instructions that lead to a desired result.

questions.stem: What does it mean to say that an algorithm is independent of any language?
options: It can only be written in English
It must be written in one specific programming language
It cannot be implemented by a computer at all
It can be implemented in any programming language
It works only on data stored in a single language
questions.explanation: An algorithm is a language-independent procedure, so it can be implemented in any programming language.

questions.stem: What does the Unambiguous characteristic of an algorithm require?
options: Each step and each input or output should be clear and lead to only one meaning
The algorithm should have no inputs at all
The algorithm should produce several different outputs for the same input
The algorithm should be written without comments
The algorithm should run in under one second
questions.explanation: Unambiguous means the algorithm is clear: every step and every input and output must have only one possible meaning.

questions.stem: How many inputs may a well-formed algorithm have?
options: Exactly one input
At least two inputs
Zero or more well-defined inputs
Exactly as many inputs as outputs
No inputs, since inputs make it ambiguous
questions.explanation: The Input characteristic states an algorithm should have zero or more well-defined inputs.

questions.stem: What does the Output characteristic of an algorithm state?
options: It may have zero outputs
It should produce an output only when there is an error
Its output does not need to match what was desired
It should always produce exactly one output
It should have one or more well-defined outputs that match the desired output
questions.explanation: An algorithm should have one or more well-defined outputs, and those outputs should match the desired output.

questions.stem: Which characteristic of an algorithm is described by Finiteness?
options: It must use a limited amount of memory
It must terminate after a finite number of steps
It must be written in fewer than one hundred lines
It must handle only a finite set of data types
It must be run a finite number of times per day
questions.explanation: Finiteness means the algorithm must come to an end after a finite number of steps rather than running forever.

questions.stem: What does the Feasibility characteristic of an algorithm mean?
options: It should be achievable with the available resources
It should be free of any inputs
It should be written by more than one developer
It should be executed on the cloud
It should be the fastest possible solution
questions.explanation: Feasibility means the algorithm should be feasible, that is, practical to carry out with the resources available.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the ways an algorithm behaves from a data point of view?
options: Search an item in a data structure
Sort items in a certain order
Insert an item into a data structure
Compress a data structure to save space
Delete an existing item from a data structure
questions.explanation: From a data point of view the listed behaviours are Search, Sort, Insert, Update and Delete; compression is not among them.

questions.stem: Which data algorithm behaviour arranges items in a certain order?
options: Search
Insert
Sort
Update
Delete
questions.explanation: A Sort algorithm arranges the items of a data structure in a certain order.

questions.stem: Which characteristic says an algorithm should have step-by-step directions that do not depend on any programming code?
options: Unambiguous
Finiteness
Feasibility
Output
Independent
questions.explanation: The Independent characteristic requires step-by-step directions that are independent of any programming code.
